outcome: Cord blood SARS-CoV-2 anti-spike IgG concentration
cohort: Pregnant women in Kilifi, Kenya, whose immunity was primarily derived from SARS-CoV-2 infection, and their newborns, from whom paired maternal delivery and cord blood samples were collected.
finding: Placental transfer of SARS-CoV-2 antibodies was evident, with a weak positive correlation between log-transformed maternal and cord blood anti-spike IgG concentrations, and a geometric mean ratio indicating no significant difference between cord and maternal anti-spike IgG concentrations.
